scope: UR5e kinematic closed-loop developmental pilot, not hardware and not held-out evaluation

reachability_witness.controller_of_archived_witness: path-guided LiuQP; historical witness only, not supplied to new controller

integrity.note: Control sources are checked against each run freeze, using retained revision copies. Post-processing/audit launch scripts were extended after motion runs; original completed trajectories/results were not overwritten.

conclusion: Integrated objective-only low-dimensional method executed real UR5e closed-loop motion but did not achieve the final goal in any of the four final modified trials. Sphere and ellipsoid original baselines both failed the same shelf task within 300 s. A historical audited guided-LiuQP trajectory establishes reachability, but was never used as controller input.
